scope: Empty failed provider catalogs and confirmed deletion of unused provider connections

catalog.loading: displayed models cleared immediately on switch and refresh
catalog.failure: selected provider remains in title; list stays empty; explicit failure message and retry action
catalog.success: same-provider highlight restored only after successful response; active model unchanged by navigation
catalog.unsupported_listing: explicit configured-catalog mode remains for backends without a listing API
catalog.stale_results: request IDs and cancellation still prevent older responses from replacing the current provider

deletion.entry: D/Delete or visible Delete action in connection list
deletion.confirmation: Cancel selected initially; explicit Delete selection required; Esc cancels
deletion.in_use_guard: agents in runtime and both loaded file layers must use another connection before deletion
deletion.layers: removes named profile and model definitions from global and current project layers, preventing shadowed profile resurrection
deletion.legacy: empty disabled marker replaces entire legacy entry including unknown child fields; suppresses env recreation and is hidden from list
deletion.secrets: saved credentials removed only from active connection definitions; no environment secret copied to disk
deletion.file_safety: private atomic replacement per file; rollback on later write failure; runtime changes only after all writes succeed
deletion.rollback_test: passed as non-root with second directory made read-only; both files preserved byte-for-byte

live.provider: local Ollama plus independent loopback catalog fixture
coverage: provider switching with xterm/CSI-u arrows and Tab
HTTP 503 catalog failure clears displayed models
retry restores the same provider catalog
confirmed deletion removes provider from connection list
conversation continues with active Ollama connection

development_findings: Updated the old UI test that expected retained models after refresh failure to match the explicitly requested empty-list behavior; successful refresh still preserves highlight
PTY caught normalized display text in delete confirmation; fixed to retain the original connection name while stripping controls
PTY fixture waited for mode label before editor submission acknowledgement; strengthened wait to require cleared command draft before next prompt
Details of a blocked deletion remain accessible through Ctrl+D on compact terminals
limits: Deletion of a connection still referenced by an agent is refused with the affected roles listed
Only loaded global and current project files are edited; other projects and backup files are not scanned
Each configuration file is atomic individually; multiple-file rollback is attempted on errors, not a filesystem-wide transaction
Catalog failure fixture uses loopback HTTP 503; live inference uses local Ollama without real external credentials
